logic_errors.summary: Fail restores gameplay presentations and removes scene input suppression while the opaque failed overlay remains and IsReady is false.
logic_errors.impact: Timeout or missing media readiness with an otherwise valid game and collection permits hidden gameplay/collection inputs; visual DrawTexture overlay does not consume events. Disable/destroy rollback and post-failure late scene activation also expose ungated input without readiness.
logic_errors.required_resolution: Retain an effective independent command/input fence through visible startup failure and late activation; preserve exact final enabled-state restoration and reachable owner-controlled Quit/error Retry. No implementation changes authorized in this review.

suggestions.summary: Upcoming NativeBaseHost success has Library null with NativeProvider populated. Adapt optional-art warning to its verified success/provider contract; Library null alone is not failure. Do not generalize null adapter into terminal success or failure.

Original boundary checks approve immediate failure restoration but do not prove absence of gameplay commands. Add permission-level error/timeout/disable/destroy/late-activation tests rather than only enabled-state rollback assertions.

Scene authoring/admission and native no-camera paint/input/lifecycle/cleanup verification remain outstanding. Managed doubles and real-reference compilation do not prove a visible functional bar or speedup.
